body:
The beach feels peaceful now, its soft sand stretching out into an endless horizon. I stand on my toes, gazing at the shimmering surface of the sea below. Each wave carries secrets from the depths, yet they carry something more—hope for new days ahead.

I let out a deep breath, feeling the air cool against my skin. With each step forward, I see clearer the outline of those unknown creatures washed ashore—a mix of seashells and remnants of their lives. Their delicate beauty stirs something in me—it’s not just survival instinct but also a touch of reverence.

My heart swells with compassion as I realize these simple objects hold stories untold. The protection I felt earlier becomes a call to action—their fragile existence calls out to me to safeguard and share this moment.
